chunks: Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amer narrated to us from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amer. He said: Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Azdi narrated to us from Aban ibn Uthman. He said: Aban ibn Taghlub narrated to us from Ikrama, from Ibn Abbas. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever wishes to live my life, die my death, enter the Garden of Eden — my abode — and grasp a branch planted by my Lord, Mighty and Majestic, to which He said 'Be!' and it was, then let him accept the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib and follow the successors from among his descendants; for they are my progeny, created from my clay. I complain to Allah about their enemies from my nation — those who deny their virtue and sever my bond through them. By Allah, my son al-Husayn will surely be killed after me, and Allah will not grant them my intercession.

key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: al-Awsiya’ - The Successors/Trustees: the designated spiritual and temporal successors from Ali’s lineage
key_terms.جَنَّةَ عَدْنٍ: Jannat Adn - Garden of Eden: the highest station of Paradise, described as the Prophet’s personal abode
key_terms.عِتْرَتِي: Itrati - My progeny/family: the Prophet’s direct descendants through Fatimah and Ali, whom he designates as rightful guides

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about following Ali ibn Abi Talib and the prophecy of Husayn's martyrdom?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through Ibn Abbas, the Prophet Muhammad declares that anyone who desires to share in his spiritual station must pledge allegiance to Ali ibn Abi Talib and follow his designated successors. The Prophet emphasizes that these successors are his own progeny, created from his essence. He delivers the devastating prophecy that his grandson al-Husayn will be martyred and his killers denied the Prophet's intercession.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (rh) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdullah b. `Amer. He said: Abu Ahmad Muhammad b. Ziyad al-Azdi narrated to us from Aban b. `Uthman. He said: Aban b. Taghlub narrated to us from `Ikrama from Ibn `Abbas. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: If it makes one happy to live my life, die my death, join my rank in the Garden of Eden, and grasp onto the bark [of a tree] planted by my Lord – after which He said “be! And it is” – then he should align with `Ali b. Abi Talib and accept the deputies from his descendants; for they are my progeny, who were created from my clay. I complain to Allah about their enemies from my Nation, who deny their virtue, who cut away my bloodline through them. By Allah! My son, al-Husayn, will be killed after me – and Allah will not give them my intercession.
